prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1061; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in at the intersection in Pearland, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the situation itself, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Let's start with what happened. Where were you traveling when the collision occurred?

A: I was driving through the intersection heading east on the main road. I had a green light, I'm pretty sure of that.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not until the last second. It came from my right side, from the cross street. I hit the brakes but there wasn't time to stop.

Q: Which part of your vehicle was struck?

A: The passenger side door and the rear quarter panel. The other car hit me almost sideways.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes, my neck. It snapped forward and then back. I've had a stiff neck and some soreness in my shoulders since then.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same day. They X-rayed me, said it looked like a neck strain, and gave me a prescription for muscle relaxers and some anti-inflammatories.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?

A: I've been working, but I've had to take a couple of breaks. Sitting at a desk for long periods is hard right now.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I'm still going to physical therapy, and I'd like to know what the next steps are for my claim.

Q: Thank you. I'll follow up with you on those items shortly.
